2.50.7 Matrix.DataElementName
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The Matrix.DataElementName element specifies the name to use for the data element of the
Matrix in a data rendering.
This element is optional. If this element is not present, its value MUST be a case-sensitive CLS-
compliant identifier [UTR15]. If this element is not present, its value is interpreted to be the value
of the Name attribute of the Matrix.
Following is the parent element of the Matrix.DataElementName element.
Parent elements
Matrix
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Matrix.DataElementName element.
 <xsd:element name="DataElementName" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
